landing.heroDescription: Zonostick automatically tracks your brand's recommendation ranking across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok, and DeepSeek - all 6 major LLMs - every morning, and alerts you on Slack the moment something shifts.
landing.benefitsTitle: What changes once you're set up
landing.benefit1Desc: 6 major AIs, checked automatically every morning - no more manually asking each one and copying down the answer.
landing.benefit2Desc: One CSV export gives you a ready-to-share file for your team meeting or your client's monthly report.
landing.benefit3Desc: See the actual text each AI wrote - not just a number - so you know exactly why you ranked where you did.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Three steps, and automated tracking starts today
landing.step1Desc: Add the brand you want to track and the competitors you want to compare against.
landing.step2Desc: Save the prompts you'd expect a real customer to ask an AI.
landing.step3Desc: Your share of voice and trend lines are already updated and waiting for you.
landing.faqQ1: Which AI models do you support?
landing.faqA1: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok, and DeepSeek - all 6.
landing.faqA2: Yes - export a CSV from the dashboard with daily trends and the raw AI responses, ready to use as a report. The Business plan also includes a print/PDF-optimized A4 report.
landing.faqA3: Yes, cancel online anytime from the dashboard's settings page.
landing.feature1Desc: Runs your saved prompts against all 6 major LLMs every morning and records exactly where your brand ranks.
landing.feature2Desc: Automatically detects when your rank drops past a threshold, or your brand disappears from the recommendation list entirely.
landing.feature3Desc: Delivers detected changes and a daily summary straight to your Slack channel in Block Kit format.
landing.feature4Desc: See how your competitors are being recommended for the same prompts, side by side.

help.title: Guide & FAQ
help.subtitle: How to use Zonostick, what the metrics mean, and answers to common questions.
help.quickStart1Desc: Add the target you want to track (company, product, or service name) and its competitors from Settings.
help.quickStart2Desc: Add the questions a prospective customer would ask an AI, from the dashboard.
help.quickStart3Desc: Starting the next morning, all 6 major LLMs are checked automatically and Slack is notified.
help.metricsMentionDesc: The percentage of AI responses to your saved prompts that featured or recommended your brand.
help.metricsRankDesc: When an AI's answer is a ranked list, this is the average position your brand appeared at. No number means it was mentioned in an unranked list or prose instead.
help.metricsShareDesc: Of all mentions across your brand and its competitors, the share that went to you.
help.faqA1: Automatically, every morning, against all 6 major LLMs.
help.faqQ2: What kind of prompts should I set up?
help.faqA2: Questions a prospective customer would actually ask an AI - e.g. "best tools for X" or "X vs Y comparison".
help.faqQ3: Can I export data for internal reporting?
help.faqA3: Yes - CSV from the dashboard, or a print/PDF-optimized A4 report from the Report page on the Business plan.
help.faqQ4: What is the purpose of aggregating "AI Exposure Rate" across completely different prompts?
help.faqA4: The overall metrics (AI Exposure Rate, Average Position) serve as macro KPIs to grasp the brand's general visibility and health across LLMs. Aggregating them allows you to track macro trends over time without getting distracted by daily prompt-level fluctuations. For specific issue analysis, please drill down using categories or individual prompt data.
